goals: Address gaps in the architectural/building-block options available in the modpack.
scope: Provide the Stone Parapet and Stone Louvered Shutter as two AMC blocks with matching items for Minecraft Java 26.2 Fabric.

Use the Macaw masonry block classes and model parents. The parapet maps vanilla Stone directly. The shutter uses the same Stone grain at matching UV coordinates, with structural lighting measured across the reference shutter's five repeated slats.

exclusions: Other materials and architectural forms, provider replacement, and IBF family integration are outside AMC.
Provider-derived resources and the release JAR remain in ignored local output. C1–C5 are historical provenance.

dependencies.reason: Target game and source of the Stone sprite and palette.
Loads the AMC and Macaw entrypoints on Fabric.
Supplies the Parapet and Shutter implementations, model parents, tags and shutter sound. The controlled build used Macaw's Windows 2.4.2 for 26.2 Fabric.

state.milestone: C9 sets the Stone Louvered Shutter's shadow depth midway between C7 and C8. Comparison against both retained sprites, packaged resource checks and three controlled Fabric GameTests passed. Owner visual verification of C9 is pending.

current.summary: Sets the Stone Louvered Shutter’s recess and bevel shadows halfway between C7 and C8.
